segments.text: In this video, we're going to use quantifix dip strips to test an organic solution for the presence of peroxides.
segments.zh: 在本视频中，我们将使用 Quantofix 浸渍试纸来检测有机溶液中是否存在过氧化物。

segments.text: This process should be done inside of a fume hood using the appropriate PPE, including safety glasses, lab coat, gloves, long pants, and closed-toed shoes.
segments.zh: 这一过程应在通风橱内进行，并穿戴适当的个人防护装备，包括安全眼镜、实验服、手套、长裤和不露脚趾的鞋。

segments.text: First, open the container and remove only as many test strips that are needed.
segments.zh: 首先，打开容器，只取出所需数量的试纸。

segments.text: Try to avoid touching the test field during handling as much as possible.
segments.zh: 在操作过程中尽量避免触碰检测区。

segments.text: We can dip the strip directly into the container because this is waste.
segments.zh: 我们可以把试纸直接浸入容器中，因为这是废液。

segments.text: If your test solution is not waste, you'll want to transfer a small amount to another container for testing to avoid potential contamination of the chemical.
segments.zh: 如果你的待测溶液不是废液，你应该取少量转移到另一个容器中进行检测，以免可能污染该化学品。

segments.text: Shake off excess liquid and wait 5 seconds.
segments.zh: 甩掉多余的液体，等待 5 秒钟。

segments.text: Quantifix instructions specify adding a drop of water after dipping the test strip when testing organic solutions.
segments.zh: Quantofix 的说明书规定，检测有机溶液时，在浸入试纸后要滴加一滴水。

segments.text: This is a really important step which greatly affects the accuracy of the results.
segments.zh: 这是非常重要的一步，会极大地影响结果的准确性。

segments.text: Notice how much the color changes after adding the drop of water.
segments.zh: 注意看滴加一滴水后颜色变化有多大。

segments.text: For consistency, we recommend adding this step when testing aqueous solutions as well, as it won't affect the results.
segments.zh: 为了保持一致，我们建议检测水溶液时也加上这一步，因为它不会影响结果。

segments.text: Next, compare the test field with the color scale.
segments.zh: 接下来，将检测区与比色卡进行比对。

segments.text: If peroxides are present, the test field will turn blue.
segments.zh: 如果存在过氧化物，检测区会变成蓝色。

segments.text: Record the peroxide level, date, and your initials on the PFC label.
segments.zh: 在 PFC 标签上记录过氧化物含量、日期和你的姓名首字母。

segments.text: Discard and replace test strips when they expire.
segments.zh: 试纸过期后要丢弃并更换。
